cards.title: 期权隐含信号与崩盘风险：美国权益期权的预测能力与机器学习证据
cards.description: 该研究基于2015至2026年间超过1200万条美国股票期权数据，重新评估了经典期权隐含信号对收益率和崩盘风险的预测能力，发现预测能力随市场环境变化，尤其在2023年后AI和大型科技股集中时期与传统结果显著不同。这对理解期权市场信息含量和风险管理有重要价值。
cards.summary: 作者使用统一的2015-2026年面板数据，分为三个时期，检验了多种期权隐含信号（如隐含波动率偏斜、价差、风险中性偏度等）对股票收益率的预测能力。事实发现：偏斜-收益关系在2015-2019年显著，但在2023-2026年变弱甚至反转；而其他信号（如IV价差和风险中性偏度）保持显著。机器学习模型在最新时期表现更好。作者观点认为预测能力是真实但依赖于市场状态，最新时期与传统结果显著不同。
cards.limitations: 研究基于美国市场期权数据，结论可能不适用于其他市场；样本期内市场结构变化大，可能受少数事件影响；机器学习模型的可解释性有限；研究中的预测能力基于历史数据，不能保证未来；主要关注短期预测，长期预测能力未知。
cards.originalTitle: Option-Implied Signals and Crash Risk: Predictability and Machine-Learning Evidence from U.S. Equity Options
keyPoints: 基于2015-2026年1200万条公司-日观测数据，覆盖10026个标的
将样本分为三个时期：低波动期（2015-2019）、高波动过渡期（2020-2022）、AI/大型科技股集中期（2023-2026）
Xing等人（2010）的偏斜-收益关系逐渐减弱：月度偏斜系数从-0.023（t=-5.5）变为不显著的-0.006（t=-1.5），三个月期限变为正（+0.016）
在联合模型中包含六种经典信号时，偏斜在最新时期不显著且符号反转
Cremers-Weinbaum IV价差和风险中性偏度在所有时期和模型中保持显著
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究揭示期权隐含信号对收益率和崩盘风险的预测能力并非恒定，而是随市场状态变化，尤其是2023年后市场结构变化可能削弱传统信号的有效性，对量化投资和风险管理具有重要启示。
cards.titleEn: Option-Implied Signals and Crash Risk: Evidence from U.S. Equity Options
cards.descriptionEn: This study reevaluates the predictive power of classic option-implied signals for returns and crash risk using a large panel of U.S. equity options from 2015 to 2026, finding that predictive power varies with market regimes, especially post-2023, which differs from pre-COVID results.
cards.summaryEn: The authors analyze a unified panel of 12.36 million firm-day observations from 2015-2026, split into three regimes, and test the predictive ability of option-implied signals such as smirk, IV spread, and risk-neutral skewness. Facts: the smirk-return relationship weakens over time, while other signals remain significant. The authors argue that predictability is real but regime-dependent.
keyPointsEn: Based on 12.36 million firm-day observations from 2015-2026 across 10,026 underlyings
Sample split into three regimes: low volatility (2015-2019), high-volatility transition (2020-2022), AI/mega-cap concentration (2023-2026)
The smirk-return relationship weakens: next-month coefficient from -0.023 (t=-5.5) to insignificant -0.006 (t=-1.5), and positive at three-month horizon (+0.016, t=+2.1)
In joint specifications with all six canonical signals, smirk is insignificant and sign changes in latest regime
IV spread and risk-neutral skewness remain significant across regimes and specifications
cards.whyItMattersEn: This study reveals that the predictive power of option-implied signals is not constant but varies with market states, especially after 2023, which has implications for quantitative investing and risk management.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on U.S. options data, conclusions may not generalize; sample period includes unique events; machine learning models have limited interpretability; predictive power is historical and not guaranteed; focus on short-term prediction.

cards.title: 多维概率预测提升电池储能系统交易效益
cards.description: 本研究提出结合多窗口平均的多重分割方法，用于构建电价的多维概率预测，并评估其在电池储能系统交易中的效用。该方法能直接生成收益的概率预测，有助于优化充放电时机和风险管理。
cards.summary: 作者基于多重分割方法，引入跨估计窗口的预测平均，并与多种既有方法对比。使用德国和西班牙日前市场2021-2024年数据评估，结果显示MS-ave方法在预测区间覆盖率、连续排序概率分数和能量分数上总体优于其他方法，并在支持电池储能系统交易策略时表现更佳，尤其当运营成本非零时。
cards.limitations: 研究仅限于德国和西班牙市场及2021-2024年数据，结论的普适性可能受限于市场结构和时间区间。此外，结果基于模拟交易，实际效果可能因市场动态和运营细节而异。
cards.originalTitle: From electricity prices to profits: multidimensional probabilistic forecasting for BESS trading
keyPoints: 提出了结合预测平均的多重分割（MS-ave）方法，用于多维概率电价预测。
MS-ave方法在PICP、CRPS和能量分数上总体优于其他对比方法。
该方法能直接构建每日收益的概率预测，有助于电池储能系统的充放电策略优化和风险管理。
验证于德国和西班牙日前市场2021-2024年数据。
在运营成本非零的情境下，MS-ave对电池储能交易策略的支持优势更明显。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为电价预测和储能系统运营提供了一种新工具，将多维概率预测直接应用于收益预测，有助于提升储能交易的决策质量和风险管理能力。
cards.titleEn: Multidimensional Probabilistic Forecasting Enhances Battery Storage Trading
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a multiple split method with forecast averaging to construct multidimensional probabilistic forecasts of electricity prices and evaluates its utility in battery energy storage system trading. The method can directly generate probabilistic profit forecasts, aiding charging/discharging scheduling and risk management.
cards.summaryEn: Building on the multiple split method, the authors incorporate forecast averaging across estimation windows and compare with established methods. Using German and Spanish day-ahead market data from 2021-2024, the results show that MS-ave generally outperforms others in PICP, CRPS, and Energy Score, and supports BESS trading strategies better, especially with non-zero operational costs.
keyPointsEn: Proposed a multiple split method with averaging (MS-ave) for multidimensional probabilistic price forecasting.
MS-ave outperforms other methods in PICP, CRPS, and Energy Score overall.
Direct probabilistic profit forecasts enable optimization of charging/discharging and risk management for BESS.
Validated on 2021-2024 data from German and Spanish day-ahead markets.
Advantage of MS-ave in BESS trading is more pronounced with non-zero operational costs.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This research provides a novel tool for price forecasting and storage operation, applying multidimensional probabilistic forecasts directly to profit prediction, enhancing decision-making and risk management in storage trading.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is limited to German and Spanish markets and 2021-2024 data; generalizability may be constrained by market structure and time frame. Additionally, results are based on simulated trading and actual performance may differ due to market dynamics and operational details.

cards.title: 金融感知图时空网络提升已实现波动率预测精度
cards.description: 该研究提出了一种新的深度学习架构FA-GSTN，将隐含波动率曲面视为动态图序列进行建模，结合金融领域知识（如期权希腊字母）和噪声处理模块，在美股期权数据集上实现了更高的已实现波动率预测精度，尤其在数据有限和市场压力时期表现更优。
cards.summary: 作者提出了FA-GSTN模型，通过构建隐含波动率曲面的时空图序列来预测已实现波动率，引入了金融感知特征和多尺度时间平滑门控及自适应鲁棒损失函数。实验显示，该模型在R²达到0.473，超过现有方法，并在仅使用一年数据时优于强基线（R² 0.372 vs 0.315），且在压力时期表现更稳健。消融实验证明了各组成部分的有效性。
cards.limitations: 结果基于特定数据集，可能不适用于所有市场；R²值虽高但仍有未解释方差；模型复杂度可能较高，影响部署；未与其他图神经网络方法全面对比。
cards.originalTitle: Graph-Based Modeling of Financial Volatility Dynamics
keyPoints: 提出FA-GSTN，将已实现波动率预测建模为隐含波动率曲面的时空图序列演化。
节点为网格点，边编码日内空间和日间时间依赖，并融入期权希腊字母等金融特征。
采用多尺度时间平滑门控和自适应鲁棒损失应对高频噪声。
在大规模期权数据集上，FA-GNST达到最佳精度（R²=0.473），并具有数据效率（一年训练R² 0.372 vs 0.315）和压力时期稳健性。
消融实验证实了时空图结构、金融感知组件和噪声处理模块的重要作用。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为波动率预测提供了一种新思路，通过显式建模时间动态和注入金融知识，显著提升了预测精度和鲁棒性，对风险管理和衍生品定价具有重要意义。
cards.titleEn: Finance-Aware Graph Spatio-Temporal Network Improves Realized Volatility Forecasting
cards.descriptionEn: This research proposes a new deep learning architecture FA-GSTN that models implied volatility surface as a dynamic graph sequence, integrating financial domain knowledge (e.g., option Greeks) and noise handling modules, achieving higher prediction accuracy for realized volatility on a large equity options dataset, especially with limited data and during market stress.
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose FA-GSTN, which forecasts realized volatility by modeling the evolution of the implied volatility surface as a spatio-temporal graph sequence, incorporating finance-aware features and a multi-scale temporal smoothing gate with adaptive robust loss. Experiments show the model achieves superior predictive accuracy with R² up to 0.473, outperforming existing methods, and demonstrates data efficiency (R² 0.372 vs 0.315 when trained on one year of data) and robustness during stress periods (2020-2021). Ablation studies confirm the importance of graph structure, finance-aware components, and noise handling modules.
keyPointsEn: Propose FA-GSTN to model realized volatility forecasting as evolution of spatio-temporal graph sequences from the implied volatility surface.
Nodes correspond to grid points; edges encode adaptive spatial (intra-day) and explicit temporal (inter-day) dependencies, with finance-aware node features like option Greeks.
Employ multi-scale temporal smoothing gate and adaptive robust loss to address high-frequency noise.
On a large-scale options dataset, FA-GSTN achieves state-of-the-art accuracy (R²=0.473), data efficiency (one-year R² 0.372 vs 0.315), and robustness during stress periods.
Ablation studies verify the vital roles of spatio-temporal graph structure, finance-aware components, and noise handling modules.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This study offers a new perspective for volatility forecasting by explicitly modeling temporal dynamics and infusing financial inductive biases, significantly improving prediction accuracy and robustness, which is important for risk management and derivatives pricing.
cards.limitationsEn: Results are based on a specific dataset and may not generalize to all markets; R² values indicate unexplained variance; model complexity may hinder deployment; no comparison with other graph-based methods.

cards.title: 多尺度TCN预测比特币显著波动：利润优化阈值提升经济意义
cards.description: 该研究提出一种结合多尺度时间卷积网络（TCN）与利润优化阈值的深度学习模型，用于预测比特币未来7天内涨幅是否超过5%，并利用链上、市场及情绪数据验证模型在财务决策中的实用性。
cards.summary: 研究使用2018年2月至2025年12月的数据，对比了提出的多尺度TCN模型与五种基线模型。结果显示，该模型AUC达到0.6316，利润为1.703，优于其他模型。作者认为该模型有助于投资者做出更优财务决策。
cards.limitations: 研究基于特定时间段（2018-2025）的数据，结果可能不适用于其他时期或加密货币；AUC和利润指标可能受市场条件影响；未提供模型在不同市场环境下的稳健性分析。
cards.originalTitle: Forecasting Economically Significant Bitcoin Moves: A Multi-Scale TCN with Profit-Optimized Thresholds
keyPoints: 研究对象为比特币未来7天内涨幅超过5%的预测
提出多尺度TCN架构，包含InceptionTCN块、CNN通道注意力和自适应平均池化
采用成对排序损失处理类别不平衡，并使用利润优化阈值
模型AUC为0.6316，利润为1.703，优于LSTM、TCN、XGBoost等基线
数据来源包括链上数据、市场数据和情绪数据
cards.whyItMatters: 比特币价格波动对投资和风险管理至关重要，该研究提供了一种更准确且利润导向的预测工具，有助于投资者和金融机构优化决策。
cards.titleEn: Forecasting Significant Bitcoin Moves with Multi-Scale TCN and Profit-Optimized Thresholds
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a deep learning model combining a multi-scale temporal convolutional network (TCN) with profit-optimized thresholds to predict whether Bitcoin's price will rise by more than 5% within the next 7 days, using on-chain, market, and sentiment data to demonstrate its usefulness in financial decision-making.
cards.summaryEn: The study uses data from February 2018 to December 2025 to compare the proposed multi-scale TCN model with five baselines. Results show the model achieves an AUC of 0.6316 and a profit of 1.703, outperforming others. The authors believe the model can help investors make better financial decisions.
keyPointsEn: Target: predicting whether Bitcoin price rises >5% within 7 days
Proposed multi-scale TCN with InceptionTCN blocks, CNN channel attention, and adaptive average pooling
Uses pairwise ranking loss to handle class imbalance and profit-optimized decision threshold
Model achieves AUC 0.6316 and profit 1.703, outperforming LSTM, TCN, XGBoost, etc.
Data includes on-chain, market, and sentiment data
cards.whyItMattersEn: Bitcoin price fluctuations are critical for investment and risk management; this study offers a more accurate and profit-oriented forecasting tool to help investors and financial institutions optimize decisions.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on a specific period (2018-2025) and may not generalize to other periods or cryptocurrencies; AUC and profit metrics may be influenced by market conditions; robustness across different market environments is not analyzed.

cards.title: 跨制度贝叶斯优化下的表格深度学习算法交易研究
cards.description: 本研究针对算法交易中信号生成问题，提出在超参数选择阶段显式考虑市场制度稳健性，并系统比较了五种表格深度学习模型与梯度提升树。研究发现，组合XGBoost和TabNet的混合模型在样本外表现优异，年化收益率51.26%，夏普比率2.44，且具有统计显著的CAPM alpha，为算法交易中的模型选择提供了新证据。
cards.summary: 该研究基于约300只美国大盘股11年的日度数据，训练五类模型，并通过贝叶斯优化针对三种不同市场制度的交易表现进行超参数选择。主要发现包括：制度稳健的超参数选择与样本外泛化相关；没有单一深度学习模型优于梯度提升树；但XGBoost与TabNet的混合集成（通过秩聚合）实现了年化收益51.26%、夏普比率2.44，CAPM alpha为0.423（p=0.011），且beta接近零，表明超额收益来自选股而非市场敞口。替代数据在技术面和基本面特征之外作用有限，且在不同模型和做多/做空方向上表现不一。作者认为交互式应用已可实时探索，但实际部署仍需集成实时数据。
cards.limitations: 研究基于美国大盘股，结论可能不适用于其他市场或小盘股。数据为日度频率，未考虑更高频交易。模拟噪声测试可能无法完全反映真实市场冲击。研究未报告交易成本、滑点等实际交易摩擦的影响。
cards.originalTitle: Tabular Deep Learning for Algorithmic Trading: Cross-Regime Bayesian Optimisation for Equity Signal Generation
keyPoints: 首次在超参数选择中显式优化跨市场制度的交易表现。
组合XGBoost和TabNet的混合集成模型表现最佳，年化收益51.26%，夏普2.44。
CAPM alpha为0.423（p=0.011），且beta接近零，说明超额收益源于选股能力。
没有单一表格深度学习模型超过梯度提升树。
替代数据在基本面和技术特征之外贡献有限，且多空不对称。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为算法交易中的模型选择和超参数优化提供了新视角，强调市场制度稳健性的重要性。混合集成方法的优异表现和可解释的alpha来源，对量化投资实践具有参考价值。
cards.titleEn: Tabular Deep Learning for Algorithmic Trading: Cross-Regime Bayesian Optimisation for Equity Signal Generation
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes incorporating market regime robustness in hyperparameter selection for algorithmic trading and systematically compares five tabular deep learning models against gradient-boosted trees. A hybrid ensemble of XGBoost and TabNet achieves strong out-of-sample performance with an annualized return of 51.26% and Sharpe ratio 2.44, along with statistically significant CAPM alpha, offering new evidence for model selection in algorithmic trading.
cards.summaryEn: The study trains five model classes on daily data from approximately 300 US large-cap equities over eleven years, using Bayesian optimization targeting trading performance across three statistically different market regimes. Key findings include: regime-robust hyperparameter selection is associated with out-of-sample generalization; no individual tabular deep learning architecture outperforms gradient-boosted trees; but a hybrid ensemble combining XGBoost and TabNet via rank aggregation achieves an annualized return of 51.26%, Sharpe ratio of 2.44, and statistically significant CAPM alpha of 0.423 (p=0.011), with near-zero beta indicating performance driven by stock selection rather than market exposure. Alternative data plays a secondary role once technical and fundamental features are accounted for, contributing more on the short side than the long and varying by model class. The authors note an interactive application makes results explorable, but live data integration remains for practical deployment.
keyPointsEn: First to explicitly optimize trading performance across market regimes during hyperparameter selection.
Hybrid ensemble of XGBoost and TabNet achieves best performance with annualized return 51.26% and Sharpe 2.44.
CAPM alpha of 0.423 (p=0.011) and near-zero beta suggest alpha comes from stock selection.
No individual tabular deep learning model outperforms gradient-boosted trees.
Alternative data adds limited value beyond fundamental and technical features, with asymmetric contributions across long/short.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This study offers a new perspective on model selection and hyperparameter optimization for algorithmic trading, emphasizing market regime robustness. The strong performance and explained alpha of the hybrid ensemble provide valuable reference for quantitative investment practice.
cards.limitationsEn: Study focuses on US large-cap stocks; findings may not generalize to other markets or small-caps. Daily frequency, not higher-frequency. Simulated noise tests may not capture real market impact. Transaction costs and slippage are not considered.

cards.title: 金融AI系统从准确性到可审计性：确定性研究综述
cards.description: 该综述系统梳理了金融AI中可复现性失败的来源，并首次通过实验量化了表格模型、图网络和LLM智能体工作流中的不确定性，提出了分层评估框架，为金融AI审计提供了新视角。
cards.summary: 本文综述了金融AI系统中可复现性挑战，包括深度学习架构和硬件导致的机械非确定性。作者通过实验量化了信用评分中解释排名不稳定性、GNN欺诈检测中的预测翻转率以及LLM实体提取中的张量并行输出分歧，并提出了一个分层评估框架，将特定模态指标（如RBO、D_cos、TDI、PSD）与审计准备度联系起来。作者认为这些指标有重叠，需联合使用。
cards.limitations: 本文基于公开数据集和有限实验，结论可能不适用于所有金融场景；指标重叠分析依赖特定实验设置。
cards.originalTitle: From Accuracy to Auditability: A Survey of Determinism in Financial AI Systems
keyPoints: 金融AI面临可复现性挑战，源于硬件和架构的机械非确定性
综述覆盖表格模型、图网络和LLM智能体工作流三种模态
第一方实验量化了信用评分、欺诈检测和实体提取中的不确定性
提出分层评估框架，关联模态特定指标与审计准备度
发现常用指标存在重叠，应互补使用而非替代
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为金融AI的可审计性提供了系统性视角，有助于监管和风险管理实践，推动AI系统在合规要求下的发展。
cards.titleEn: From Accuracy to Auditability: A Survey of Determinism in Financial AI Systems
cards.descriptionEn: This survey systematically reviews sources of reproducibility failures in financial AI and, for the first time, quantifies uncertainty in tabular models, graph networks, and LLM-based agentic workflows through experiments, proposing a layered evaluation framework for audit readiness.
cards.summaryEn: The article reviews reproducibility challenges in financial AI, including mechanical nondeterminism from deep learning architectures and hardware. The authors quantify explanation rank instability in credit scoring, prediction flip rates in GNN fraud detection, and tensor-parallel-induced output divergence in LLM entity extraction, and propose a layered evaluation framework linking modality-specific metrics (e.g., RBO, D_cos, TDI, PSD) to audit readiness. They argue that these metrics overlap and should be used complementarily.
keyPointsEn: Financial AI faces reproducibility challenges from mechanical nondeterminism in hardware and architecture
Survey covers tabular models, graph networks, and LLM-based agentic workflows
First-party experiments quantify uncertainty in credit scoring, fraud detection, and entity extraction
Proposes layered evaluation framework linking modality-specific metrics to audit readiness
Finds that common metrics overlap, suggesting complementary use
cards.whyItMattersEn: This research provides a systematic perspective on auditability of financial AI, aiding regulatory and risk management practices, and promoting development of AI systems under compliance requirements.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on public datasets and limited experiments; conclusions may not generalize to all financial scenarios; overlap analysis depends on specific experimental setups.

cards.title: 标普500相关矩阵主成分的经济物理学分析
cards.description: 本研究从经济物理学视角，将金融市场视为复杂系统，通过主成分分析揭示标普500指数集体动态的新见解。它不仅有助理解市场状态与危机时期资产参与度的变化，还为投资组合设计和交易策略提供概念与方法工具。
cards.summary: 研究使用430家公司的日对数收益率，构建滑动窗口下的时间相关矩阵，并通过主特征值、主特征向量及其截断重建来分析谱结构。通过k-Means聚类识别出市场状态，评估了聚类稳定性，计算了转移矩阵和静态分布。研究发现COVID-19期间表现为非典型状态，需要多个主成分才能重建；危机期间相对参与度分布到更多资产；2017-2018年区间虽影响动态但未形成孤立体制。作者指出该分析是描述性而非预测性的。
cards.limitations: 分析是描述性的，不提供预测能力；结果依赖于特定参数（如窗口长度q和聚类数k）；仅基于标普500指数，可能不适用于其他市场；使用线性相关矩阵，可能无法捕捉非线性关系。
cards.originalTitle: Analysis of the Principal Components of Correlation Matrices of S&P 500 Financial Data from an Econophysics Perspective
keyPoints: 使用经济物理学方法分析标普500指数，构建时间相关矩阵并研究其谱结构。
通过k-Means聚类识别市场状态，使用最大特征值、主特征向量平方项和截断矩阵重建C^l。
COVID-19期间表现为非典型状态，需要多个主成分（C^2和C^3）才能重建，尤其在窗长q=40和k=5时。
危机期间相对参与度分布在更多资产上，而2017-2018年区间未形成孤立体制。
分析是描述性的，而非预测性的，为投资组合和交易策略提供概念工具。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提供了理解金融市场集体行为的新视角，通过识别市场状态和危机模式，有助于风险管理、投资组合多样化和交易策略制定，并可扩展到其他国际交易所。
cards.titleEn: Econophysics Analysis of Principal Components of S&P 500 Correlation Matrices
cards.descriptionEn: From an econophysics perspective, this study treats the financial market as a complex system and reveals new insights into the collective dynamics of the S&P 500 via principal component analysis. It aids in understanding market states and changes in asset participation during crises, and offers conceptual and methodological tools for portfolio design and trading strategies.
cards.summaryEn: The study uses daily logarithmic returns of 430 companies to construct time-dependent Pearson correlation matrices over sliding windows, analyzing spectral structure via leading eigenvalues and eigenvectors. k-Means clustering identifies market states, with stability assessed and transition matrices and stationary vectors computed. COVID-19 emerges as an atypical state requiring more than one principal component for reconstruction, especially with window length q=40 and k=5. During crises, relative participation spreads over more assets, while the 2017-2018 interval contributes without forming an isolated regime. The analysis is descriptive, not predictive.
keyPointsEn: Econophysics approach to analyze S&P 500, constructing time-varying correlation matrices and studying spectral structure.
k-Means clustering identifies market states using largest eigenvalue, squared eigenvector entries, and truncated matrix reconstructions C^l.
COVID-19 is an atypical state requiring multiple principal components (C^2 and C^3) for reconstruction, especially at window length q=40 and k=5.
During crises, relative participation spreads over more assets, while 2017-2018 does not appear as an isolated regime.
The analysis is descriptive, not predictive, providing conceptual tools for portfolio and trading strategies.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This study offers a new perspective on collective behavior in financial markets, aiding risk management, portfolio diversification, and trading strategy development by identifying market states and crisis patterns, with extensions to other exchanges.
cards.limitationsEn: The analysis is descriptive without predictive power; results depend on specific parameters (e.g., window length q and cluster number k); based solely on S&P 500, may not generalize to other markets; uses linear correlations, possibly missing nonlinear effects.

cards.title: 融合因果图的时序卷积网络在零售电价预测中的可解释性与精度提升
cards.description: 该研究提出了一种名为CG-TCN的预测架构，将学习到的因果图嵌入时序卷积网络，在提升零售电价预测精度的同时增强模型的可解释性。通过对俄亥俄州放松管制市场十年数据的验证，该方法不仅准确预测了未来1、10、15天的电价，还揭示了批发电价和合同属性对零售电价的不同影响机制，为市场分析、监管和风险管理提供了清晰依据。
cards.summary: 研究引入CG-TCN架构，利用多分辨率分解和因果图发现，将因果信息嵌入时序卷积网络。基于俄亥俄州的真实数据，该方法在预测精度上优于基准模型，并提供了可解释的因果路径。作者认为该方法结合了性能与透明度，有助于市场决策，但结论基于特定市场和时间范围，推广需谨慎。
cards.limitations: 研究基于单一地区（俄亥俄州）的数据，结论可能不适用于其他市场结构；预测性能未与所有可能的先进模型对比；因果图的学习可能受数据质量影响；未明确模型的泛化能力。
cards.originalTitle: A causal graph-informed temporal convolution architecture for interpretable retail electricity price forecasting
keyPoints: 提出CG-TCN架构，集成因果图与时间卷积网络，提升零售电价预测的可解释性和准确性。
使用多分辨率分解分离长期趋势与高频波动，并发现批发电价和合同属性的因果作用。
在俄亥俄州10年数据上，一步、十步、十五步预测的MAPE分别为3.08%、3.82%和5.43%，优于基准模型。
研究发现批发电价主导长期趋势，合同属性影响短期波动。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为零售电价预测提供了兼具高精度和可解释性的新方法，有助于市场参与者理解价格驱动因素，支持监管评估和消费者保护，并可用于风险评估和采购规划。
cards.titleEn: Interpretable Retail Electricity Price Forecasting via Causal Graph-Informed Temporal Convolutional Networks
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a forecasting architecture called CG-TCN, which integrates a learned causal graph into a temporal convolutional network to improve both accuracy and interpretability of retail electricity price forecasting. Validated on ten years of data from Ohio's deregulated market, the method not only accurately predicts electricity prices 1, 10, and 15 days ahead but also reveals distinct impacts of wholesale prices and contract attributes, providing clear insights fo
cards.summaryEn: The study introduces the CG-TCN architecture, which utilizes multi-resolution decomposition and causal graph discovery to embed causal information into temporal convolutional networks. Based on real data from Ohio, the method outperforms benchmark models in prediction accuracy and offers interpretable causal pathways. The authors state that the method combines performance and transparency, aiding market decisions, but conclusions are based on a specific market and time frame, so generalization should be cautious.
keyPointsEn: A CG-TCN architecture integrating causal graphs and temporal convolutional networks improves interpretability and accuracy of retail electricity price forecasting.
Multi-resolution decomposition separates long-term trends from high-frequency fluctuations, revealing causal effects of wholesale prices and contract attributes.
On Ohio's 10-year data, MAPE values for 1-, 10-, and 15-step-ahead forecasts are 3.08%, 3.82%, and 5.43%, respectively, outperforming benchmarks.
Wholesale prices mainly drive long-term trends, while contract attributes influence short-term fluctuations.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This study provides a novel method for retail electricity price forecasting that combines high accuracy and interpretability, helping market participants understand price drivers, supporting regulatory assessments and consumer protection, and applicable to risk assessment and procurement planning.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on data from a single region (Ohio), so conclusions may not apply to other market structures; predictive performance is not compared with all possible state-of-the-art models; causal graph learning may be affected by data quality; the generalization ability of the model is not clearly evaluated.

cards.title: Claude Code v2.1.248：新增受限模式及多项修复
cards.description: 该版本引入了 `--restricted` 标志以限制工具权限，增加了实验性的缓存 TTL 设置和诊断功能，并修复了多项稳定性问题。对于使用 Claude Code 的开发者，此更新增强了安全性和可靠性。
cards.summary: 该更新主要新增了受限模式、实验性缓存 TTL、自托管运行器标签、服务器管理设置诊断等功能，并修复了包括提示缓存未命中、会话时间线、Windows 终端问题等多项缺陷。事实部分来自官方更新日志，观点部分为编辑总结。
cards.limitations: 受限模式仍允许通过 `--tools` 显式指定的工具。实验性缓存 TTL 可能需要根据实际工作负载进行测试。部分修复（如 OAuth 登录）可能仍受具体环境限制。
keyPoints: 新增 `--restricted` 标志：移除内置的命令执行和代码运行工具，并限制文件工具在当前工作目录内。
新增 `experimental.cacheTtl` 设置：允许为子代理设置提示缓存 TTL。
新增 `claude self-hosted-runner --client-label` 参数：覆盖运行器注册的标签。
新增服务器管理设置诊断：启动时警告设置加载失败，并提供 `/doctor` 和 `/status` 说明。
修复长时间会话中约每小时发生一次的提示缓存未命中问题。
cards.whyItMatters: 该版本增强了 Claude Code 的安全控制，通过受限模式限制了工具权限，同时通过诊断和修复多项问题提升了工具的稳定性和用户体验。对于依赖 Claude Code 进行自动化任务的开发者，这些改进有助于减少中断和提高生产力。
cards.titleEn: Claude Code v2.1.248: New Restricted Mode and Many Fixes
cards.descriptionEn: This release introduces a `--restricted` flag to limit tool permissions, an experimental cache TTL setting, diagnostics, and fixes many stability issues. For developers using Claude Code, this update improves security and reliability.
cards.summaryEn: The update primarily adds a restricted mode, experimental cache TTL, self-hosted runner labels, server-managed settings diagnostics, and fixes numerous defects including prompt cache misses, session timelines, and Windows terminal issues. Facts are from the official changelog; opinions are editorial summaries.
keyPointsEn: Added `--restricted` flag: removes built-in command/code execution tools and restricts file tools to working directory.
Added `experimental.cacheTtl` setting: per-agent prompt cache TTL.
Added `claude self-hosted-runner --client-label` to override runner label.
Added server-managed settings diagnostics: startup warning on load failure, `/doctor` and `/status` lines.
Fixed prompt cache miss roughly once an hour in long sessions.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This release enhances security control of Claude Code by adding restricted mode limiting tool permissions, and improves stability and user experience through diagnostics and many fixes. For developers relying on Claude Code for automation, these improvements help reduce interruptions and boost productivity.
cards.limitationsEn: Restricted mode still allows explicitly specified tools via `--tools`. Experimental cache TTL may require testing with real workloads. Some fixes (e.g., OAuth login) may still be limited by specific environments.

cards.title: AI周报：机器无权利；SPADE自动化环境生成；Hawkeye优化GPU内核
cards.description: 本报告编译自Import AI第470期，涵盖三大热点：关于机器权利的伦理讨论、SPADE系统实现自动化环境生成、以及Hawkeye工具助力GPU内核性能优化。为AI开发者、研究者和政策制定者提供前沿动态与实用参考。
cards.summary: 本期Import AI聚焦于AI领域的多个前沿议题。首先探讨了机器权利的法律与伦理争议，指出当前法律体系不赋予AI人格地位。其次介绍了SPADE系统，其通过自动生成环境以提升强化学习智能体的泛化能力。最后展示了Hawkeye工具，用于分析和优化GPU内核性能，提高计算效率。文中观点仅代表作者，事实部分基于原文报道。
cards.limitations: 原文为综述性质，未提供实证数据支持；机器权利讨论属观点性内容，非法律结论；SPADE和Hawkeye的具体效果未在本期报告中提供量化结果。
cards.originalTitle: Import AI 470: No rights for machines; automating environment generation with SPADE; and building better GPU kernels with Hawkeye
keyPoints: 机器权利：法律与伦理上不授予AI人格地位，需谨慎处理相关责任归属。
SPADE：自动化生成多样化训练环境，增强智能体在未知环境中的适应能力。

趋势：AI系统能力增强，但责任与风险控制需同步跟进。
cards.whyItMatters: 这些进展分别触及AI伦理、自动化和性能优化，对技术开发、政策制定和行业应用均有启示。机器权利的讨论关乎法规设计；SPADE的自动化环境生成可加速RL训练；Hawkeye则直接提升基础设施效率，三者共同反映了AI领域的多维度进步。
cards.titleEn: AI Weekly: No Rights for Machines; SPADE Automates Environments; Hawkeye Boosts GPU Kernels
cards.descriptionEn: This report summarizes key highlights from Import AI issue 470, covering ethical debates on machine rights, the SPADE system for automated environment generation, and the Hawkeye tool for GPU kernel optimization, offering insights for developers, researchers, and policymakers.
cards.summaryEn: Import AI #470 discusses several frontier issues. It examines the legal and ethical debate over machine rights, noting that current laws do not grant AI legal personhood. It introduces SPADE, which automates environment generation to improve generalization in reinforcement learning agents. It also presents Hawkeye, a tool for profiling and optimizing GPU kernels to enhance computational efficiency. The views expressed are the author's; facts are based on the original report.
keyPointsEn: Machine rights: Legal and ethical frameworks do not confer legal personhood on AI, requiring careful consideration of responsibility.
SPADE: Automates generation of diverse training environments to boost agent adaptability in unseen scenarios.
Hawkeye: Profiles and optimizes GPU kernels, significantly improving execution efficiency.
Trend: As AI systems grow capable, responsibility and risk management must advance in tandem.
cards.whyItMattersEn: These developments touch on AI ethics, automation, and performance optimization, with implications for technology development, policy, and industry. The machine rights debate informs regulation; SPADE's automated environment generation can accelerate RL training; Hawkeye directly improves infrastructure efficiency, reflecting multidimensional progress in AI.
cards.limitationsEn: The original article is a review and does not provide empirical data; the machine rights discussion is opinion-based, not a legal conclusion; specific effects of SPADE and Hawkeye lack quantitative results in this issue.

cards.title: Chatbox v1.22.3：修复长对话卡顿与备份兼容性问题
cards.description: 本次更新针对Chatbox AI助手应用，修复了长对话中重新生成回复或切换回复分支时的延迟问题，并提升了备份导出在不同设备上的兼容性。对于依赖长对话进行复杂任务处理的用户，可显著提升操作流畅度；同时增强数据迁移的可靠性。
cards.summary: Chatbox v1.22.3版本主要包含两项修复：一是解决了长对话中重新生成回复或切换分支时的卡顿问题，二是改进了备份导出的兼容性，修复了部分设备上的导出失败。这些修复基于用户反馈的问题，属于性能优化和稳定性改进。文中未提及新增功能或其他变化。
cards.limitations: 本次更新仅针对性能优化和备份功能修复，未涉及新功能或安全改进。修复效果的具体验证依赖于实际应用场景，且仅针对已报告的设备问题，无法保证所有设备完全兼容。
keyPoints: 修复了长对话中重新生成回复或切换回复分支时的延迟问题。
改进了备份导出兼容性，修复了部分设备上备份失败的情况。
版本号v1.22.3，发布于2026年8月9日。
提供多平台下载，涵盖macOS、Windows、Linux及Android。
cards.whyItMatters: 对于使用Chatbox进行长时间、复杂对话的用户，卡顿问题直接影响使用体验，本次修复能明显提升操作流畅度。同时备份导出功能的兼容性增强，确保用户数据能够安全迁移和保存，对数据可靠性要求高的用户至关重要。
cards.titleEn: Chatbox v1.22.3: Fixes Lag in Long Conversations and Backup Compatibility
cards.descriptionEn: This update to the Chatbox AI assistant app fixes lag when regenerating replies or switching response branches in long conversations, and improves backup export compatibility on various devices. Users who rely on long conversations for complex tasks will benefit from improved fluidity, and the backup fix enhances data migration reliability.
cards.summaryEn: Chatbox v1.22.3 includes two main fixes: resolving the lag when regenerating replies or switching branches in long conversations, and improving backup export compatibility to prevent failures on some devices. These fixes address user-reported issues, focusing on performance and stability. No new features were mentioned.
keyPointsEn: Fixed lag when regenerating replies or switching response branches in long conversations.
Improved backup export compatibility, fixing failures on some devices.
Version v1.22.3 released on August 9, 2026.
Available for macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android.
cards.whyItMattersEn: For users engaged in lengthy and complex conversations, lag directly impacts usability, and this fix significantly improves smoothness. The enhanced backup export compatibility ensures data can be safely migrated and preserved, which is critical for users who value data reliability.
cards.limitationsEn: This update focuses solely on performance and backup fixes; no new features or security enhancements were introduced. The effectiveness of these fixes depends on actual usage and only addresses previously reported issues, so full compatibility across all devices is not guaranteed.

cards.title: 强化学习控制混合交通中CAV车队加入策略
cards.description: 该研究提出一个通用建模与仿真框架，用于评估深度强化学习算法在混合交通环境下控制CAV车队加入操作的性能。新发现是PPO算法在加入成功率和碰撞率上优于DQN和DDQN，并揭示了安全性与效率之间的权衡。
cards.summary: 该研究基于SUMO仿真和智能体建模，对比了DQN、DDQN和PPO三种强化学习算法在CAV车队加入场景中的表现。事实发现包括：PPO算法的加入成功率达约98%，碰撞率低于1%，但需要更多决策步骤；外部安全控制器能避免碰撞但降低加入效率。作者观点认为，设计基于强化学习的控制器时需联合考虑安全与效率。
cards.limitations: 研究基于仿真环境，未考虑真实交通中的通信延迟、传感器噪声等因素；参与者为算法对比，未涉及实车测试；外部安全控制器对效率的具体影响未量化；结论可能受仿真参数设置影响。
cards.originalTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Control of CAV Platoon Joining Maneuvers in Mixed Traffic
keyPoints: 提出一个通用框架，用于研究混合交通中CAV车队加入操作，并评估深度强化学习算法
对比DQN、DDQN和PPO三种算法，PPO表现最佳，加入成功率约98%，碰撞率低于1%
PPO的优异性能归因于在奖励函数中加入风险相关惩罚
PPO需要更多决策步骤完成加入操作，揭示安全性与决策效率之间的权衡
外部安全控制器可有效防止碰撞，但可能降低加入效率
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为混合交通下CAV车队加入控制提供了系统性的评估框架，明确指出强化学习算法在安全与效率间的权衡，为实际部署安全高效的CAV控制策略提供了重要的实证依据和设计启示。
cards.titleEn: Reinforcement Learning for CAV Platoon Joining in Mixed Traffic: A Simulation Study
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a generic modeling and simulation framework to evaluate deep reinforcement learning algorithms for CAV platoon joining in mixed traffic. It finds that PPO outperforms DQN and DDQN in success and collision rates, and reveals a trade-off between safety and efficiency.
cards.summaryEn: Based on SUMO simulations and agent-based modeling, this study compares DQN, DDQN, and PPO in CAV platoon joining scenarios. Facts include PPO achieving about 98% success rate and below 1% collision rate at the cost of more decision steps, and an external safety controller preventing collisions but reducing efficiency. The authors argue that safety and efficiency must be jointly considered when designing RL-based controllers.
keyPointsEn: A generic framework is proposed to study CAV platoon joining in mixed traffic and evaluate deep RL algorithms
PPO outperforms DQN and DDQN, achieving about 98% success rate and below 1% collision rate
PPO's superior performance is attributed to risk-related penalties in the reward function
PPO requires more decision steps, revealing a trade-off between safety and decision efficiency
An external safety controller effectively prevents collisions but may reduce joining efficiency
cards.whyItMattersEn: This research provides a systematic evaluation framework for CAV platoon joining control in mixed traffic, highlights the safety-efficiency trade-off in RL algorithms, and offers empirical insights for designing safe and efficient CAV control strategies in real-world deployment.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on simulations without accounting for communication delays or sensor noise; no real-vehicle tests are conducted; the impact of the external safety controller on efficiency is not quantified; results may be affected by simulation parameters.
